memory_candidates.content: Mathlib's unusedFintypeInType/unusedDecidableInType linters fire only on theorems and only for Fintype/Decidable* binders absent from the type; a [Finite X] binder is never linted. Restating over [Finite X] with haveI := Fintype.ofFinite X; haveI := Classical.decEq X in the proof is strictly stronger, and every [Fintype]-context caller still elaborates via the priority-900 instance Finite.of_fintype, so such restatements propagate zero consumer edits.
